title: Evaluating the Robustness of Proof Autoformalization in Lean 4
authors_zh: Zhengtao Gui, Sheng Yang, Zhouxing Shi
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** Global and local perturbations on miniF2F and MATH-500 test Lean autoformalization robustness.
在 miniF2F 与 MATH-500 上用全局和局部扰动测试 Lean 自动形式化鲁棒性。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Proof-autoformalization models are usually tested on polished, error-free informal proofs, so evaluations cannot determine whether they faithfully understand input. Models may produce inconsistent results after paraphrases or ignore local changes to values, symbols, or proof steps and revert to a memorized original statement.

This work constructs a robustness benchmark with global rewrites and local counterfactual perturbations, using Lean compilation and structured comparison to evaluate correctness stability and semantic faithfulness under changed wording.

自动形式化模型通常只在措辞规范、无错误的自然语言证明上测试，无法判断它是否真正忠实理解输入。模型可能在同义改写后生成不一致结果，也可能面对局部数值、符号或步骤修改时忽略变化，恢复成记忆中的原命题。

该论文通过全局改写与局部反事实扰动构造 robustness benchmark，并用 Lean 编译与结构化比较自动检查模型在表述变化下的正确性稳定和语义忠实度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The benchmark derives two data types from informal proofs in miniF2F and MATH-500. Global perturbations change style, wording, or organization while preserving meaning. Local perturbations alter a value, symbol, or proof step and require the formalization to reflect that change, even when the resulting proof is counterfactual. Records include original and perturbed proofs, expected changes, model Lean outputs, compilation results, and consistency or faithfulness labels. The release supports robustness diagnosis rather than large-scale proof SFT.

benchmark 基于 miniF2F 与 MATH-500 的自然语言证明构造两类数据。global perturbation 改变风格、句式或组织但保持语义；local perturbation 修改数值、符号或某一步，要求形式化结果相应变化，即使新证明可能为反事实。每条记录保存原证明、扰动证明、预期变化、模型 Lean 输出、编译结果及一致性/忠实度标签。官方代码和数据用于 autoformalization robustness 诊断，而非大规模证明 SFT。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select benchmark proofs: Informal proofs from miniF2F and MATH-500 are paired with Lean targets, and original formalizations are checked.
  1. Generate global perturbations: Style, order, and wording are rewritten without changing mathematical meaning, producing input pairs that should retain semantics.
  1. Generate local perturbations: Numbers, variables, relations, or proof steps are changed deliberately, with required corresponding changes in formal output recorded.
  1. Run models and Lean: Seven models produce Lean 4 formalizations. The compiler checks syntax and proof correctness, while structured rules compare consistency and reflection of local edits.
  1. Aggregate robustness: Global correctness stability and local faithfulness are reported separately to distinguish wording sensitivity from ignored input changes.

1. 选择基准证明： 从 miniF2F 与 MATH-500 取得可对应 Lean 目标的自然语言证明，并确认原始形式化可检查。
  1. 生成全局扰动： 在不改变数学含义的前提下重写风格、顺序和措辞，形成应保持同一语义的输入对。
  1. 生成局部扰动： 定向替换数字、变量、关系或证明步骤，并记录形式输出中必须同步改变的元素。
  1. 执行模型与 Lean： 七个模型生成 Lean 4 形式化，编译器检查语法与证明正确性；结构化规则比较原/扰动输出的一致性和局部反映。
  1. 汇总鲁棒性： 分别报告全局正确性稳定和局部忠实率，定位模型是表述敏感还是忽略输入修改。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates seven recent models. All are clearly sensitive to global rewrites, and most fail to faithfully reflect local perturbations: some reproduce the original formalization, while others silently repair counterfactual input. Lean compilation provides a reproducible correctness oracle, and local comparison directly checks whether edits enter the formal statement. The evidence shows current autoformalizers are not stable translators. The abstract reports neither a consolidated dataset size nor one best score, so inferred numbers should not be added.
论文评测 7 个近期模型，所有模型都对全局改写表现出明显敏感性，并且大多数在局部扰动下无法忠实反映修改：有的直接复现原形式化，有的擅自修正反事实输入。Lean 编译提供可重复的正确性 oracle，局部比较则直接检查变化是否进入 formal statement。证据支持现有 autoformalizer 并非稳定翻译器；但摘要未给出统一数据规模和单一最佳分数，不应补写推测数字。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing autoformalization benchmarks ask only whether a polished proof can be translated into compiling Lean. This work separates robustness into two contracts: correctness and consistency should survive meaning-preserving rewrites, while meaning-changing edits should be reflected faithfully rather than repaired. It makes counterfactual faithfulness a programmatic evaluation target. The contribution is perturbation data and metrics, not a new prover.
既有 autoformalization benchmark 只问“给定标准证明能否生成可编译 Lean”。本文的新意是将鲁棒性拆成两个不同合同：意义保持改写下应保持正确与一致，意义改变扰动下应忠实改变，而不是自动纠正。它首次把 counterfactual faithfulness 设为程序化评测对象；新贡献是扰动数据和指标，不是新的证明模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Perturbation naturalness: Automatic or templated rewrites may not resemble real student proofs, so failures may not represent general robustness. Naturalness requires human review.
  1. Local-comparison boundary: Lean permits many equivalent expressions for one meaning, so string or local AST rules may misjudge. Theorem-equivalence checks may be needed.
  1. Data coverage: miniF2F and MATH-500 focus on competition mathematics and omit research proofs, definition changes, and long dependency contexts.

1. 扰动自然性： 自动或模板化改写可能不像真实学生证明，模型失败未必代表一般鲁棒性；应人工审查样本自然度。
  1. 局部比较边界： Lean 中同一语义可有多种等价表达，字符串或局部 AST 规则可能误判；必要时结合定理等价检查。
  1. 数据覆盖： miniF2F 与 MATH-500 以竞赛数学为主，未覆盖研究级证明、定义变化和长依赖环境。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Model regression testing: Report original, global-perturbation, and local-perturbation results when upgrading autoformalizers, preventing optimization only for polished input.
  1. Faithfulness training: Form contrastive records from original proofs, edited proofs, and expected Lean changes to train attention to input differences rather than familiar statements.
  1. Data auditing: Use local counterfactuals to detect memorized benchmark formalizations, after validating perturbations and handling equivalent Lean expressions.

1. 模型回归测试： 在升级 autoformalizer 时同时报告原题、全局扰动和局部扰动结果，防止只优化标准输入。
  1. 忠实度训练： 将原证明—修改证明—预期 Lean 变化组成对比数据，训练模型关注输入差异而非恢复熟悉命题。
  1. 数据审计： 用局部反事实测试判断模型是否记忆 benchmark formalization；复用前需确认扰动合法并处理 Lean 等价表达。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: Global and local perturbations on miniF2F and MATH-500 test Lean autoformalization robustness.
  1. Method hook: Global rewrites should preserve semantics, whereas local edits must be faithfully reflected; these contracts cannot collapse into accuracy.
  1. Data hook: Original and perturbed proofs, expected changes, Lean outputs, compilation, and faithfulness labels are stored.
  1. Evidence anchor: All seven models are sensitive to global rewrites, and most mishandle local counterfactual edits.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits robustness and memorization audits after checking perturbation naturalness and formal equivalence.

1. 一句话定位： 在 miniF2F 与 MATH-500 上用全局和局部扰动测试 Lean 自动形式化鲁棒性。
  1. 方法抓手： 全局改写应保持语义，局部修改必须被忠实反映，两个合同不能混为正确率。
  1. 数据抓手： 保存原/扰动证明、预期变化、Lean 输出、编译与忠实度标签。
  1. 证据锚点： 7 个模型均受全局改写影响，多数无法忠实处理局部反事实变化。
  1. 复用决定： 适合鲁棒性与记忆审计；复用前检查扰动自然性和形式表达等价性。
